releaseNotes: NEW: Formula is now a repeating per-clip motion pattern (clip 1 → motion 1, clip 2 → motion 2, then repeats) — one clip gets exactly one primary motion
24 motion presets (Basic / Cinematic / Premium), 20+ formula patterns, 20 transitions, 24 effects — every card has a live preview
Safe-scale rendering: the cover scale is computed from your actual pan/slide/rotation — black or empty edges during motion are no longer possible
All motion timing is normalized to each clip's own duration (works on 2s and 10s clips alike; no hardcoded 5s)
Optional hold timing per pattern step, and optional per-step transitions
Preview and export share one renderer: what you see in the preview is exactly what the MP4 contains
Favorites for motions / formulas / effects / transitions
More reliable export validation, progress reporting, play and share
